points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers and amounts read correctly, with the currency beside the right figure?
Are the three groups clearly separated and titled?
Does every row with a chevron show it on the left, pointing left?
Do the toggles sit on the left end of their rows?
Does an on toggle look on, with its knob on the correct side?
Does the phone number +973 3600 1234 keep its plus sign and order?
Are the labels on the right edge and easy to scan?
